info.title: Streamarr Core Server API
info.description: Interface-agnostic API for Usenet search, resolve, and byte-range streaming (BRIEF §6.2).

post.summary: Exchange admin credentials for a short-lived session token.
Rotate the browser refresh token and issue a fresh access session.
Revoke and expire the browser admin session.

get.summary: The identity behind the presented bearer token (machine or admin).

post.summary: Change the signed-in admin's password.

Manually purges one idle ephemeral file from the server-owned cache. Refuses with 409
while the file is being actively streamed so operator cleanup never interrupts playback.

put.summary: Atomically assigns contiguous priorities in the supplied full order.

post.summary: Run a `t=caps` roundtrip against the stored indexer, reporting latency.

get.summary: Downloads the raw cached .nzb file so an administrator can hand it to another tool.

put.summary: Atomically assigns contiguous priorities in the supplied full order.

post.summary: Connect + AUTHINFO against the stored provider; report achievable connections.

Transfer real article bodies through the stored provider and report NNTP throughput
plus conservative video-streaming headroom. This consumes provider traffic.
Idempotent manual start: an existing active job for the release is returned as-is.

get.summary:
Capability-token-bound repair status for a live session: possession of the stream
token authorizes exactly this release's repair progress (same model as /timeline).

post.summary:
Appends client-observed spans (Jellyfin's PlaybackInfo→first delivered frame) to a live
session's request→first-frame timeline so the stream page flamegraph spans both processes.
The capability token is the authorization (same model as the anonymous close), so this
stays player-agnostic and needs no machine credential in the player.

get.summary: WebVTT segment aligned with the video segment of the same index; cue times are on the media timeline.

delete.summary: Ends the session and its ffmpeg run; any holder of the playlist capability may stop it.

post.summary: Re-runs detection including the real hardware encode/decode self-tests; poll GET until `detecting` is false.
Queues a flat-out transcode of a test sample with the live pipeline; runs execute one at a time.
Starts an HLS rendition (remux or transcode; mode defaults to transcode) of a live stream capability or a test sample.
Explains direct play → remux → transcode for this client (mode defaults to auto), without starting ffmpeg.

put.summary: Partial update; switching `enabled` off makes every viewer endpoint answer 404 `module_disabled`.

post.summary: Sends a test message synchronously and reports transport errors.

get.summary: Messages captured while email delivery runs in test-outbox mode (newest first).

post.summary: Create a viewer; an omitted password is generated and returned exactly once.
Assign a password (or generate one); signs the viewer out everywhere.
Remove a lost authenticator and its recovery codes.

get.summary: Which sign-in methods a viewer client should offer.

post.summary: Sign in with username (or verified email) and password; may answer with a second-factor challenge.
Finish a sign-in with an authenticator or recovery code.
Email a one-time sign-in code. Always 202 so the response does not reveal whether the account exists.
Sign in with an emailed one-time code; may answer with a second-factor challenge.
Email a password-reset code. Always 202 so the response does not reveal whether the account exists.
Set a new password with an emailed reset code; signs the viewer out everywhere.
Rotate the refresh token (body or cookie) and receive a fresh access token.
End the current viewer session (access token, refresh token, or cookies).

get.summary: TMDB movie/series candidates for a query (no indexer search); titles the viewer may not watch are hidden.
Home rows (trending and popular movies and series) from TMDB, cached for hours.
One page of a Movies or Series library page (TMDB discover by genre and sort); titles the viewer may not watch are hidden.
TMDB genres of movies or series for the browse filter, cached for hours.
Movie details with the viewer's watch state and age-gate decision.
Series details, season summaries and the viewer's progress (next episode, played counts).
Season episodes with watch state; `availability=true` adds version counts (cached indexer search, `refresh=true` repeats it).
Ranked versions (cached indexer search, `refresh=true` repeats it); a `videoCodecs` device profile adds `predictedMethod` and orders by what plays without a server transcode.

post.summary: Change the password; every other device is signed out.
Set, change or remove the email address; a new address is confirmed with an emailed code.
Start authenticator-app enrolment; returns the secret and an otpauth:// URI for a QR code.
Confirm enrolment with a first code; returns the one-time recovery codes.
Starts preparing a playback; poll `GET {playbackId}` until `ready` or `failed`.

get.summary: The playback's state; once `ready` it carries the URL, method, engine, media info and why. `waitMs` (up to 10000) long-polls until the state changes.

post.summary: Re-plans at a position with another audio/subtitle track, engine, quality or version; the previous URL stays valid for a short grace period after the new one is ready.
Ends the playback: stops its remux/transcode sessions and frees the stream slot.
Report playback of a movie or episode (start, periodic progress, stop); a server `playbackId` fills in release and stream token, keeps that playback alive, and `stop` ends it.
Mark works played; season and series ids expand to all aired episodes via TMDB.
Mark works unplayed (clears position, played flag and play count).

get.summary: Continue watching: works with a resume position, most recent first.

delete.summary: Hide a work from continue watching without changing its played state.

get.summary: The next episode to watch for each recently watched series.
Everything the viewer has played or started, most recent first.

post.summary: Watch state for specific movie/episode ids; unknown ids come back unplayed.

get.summary: All recorded episode states of one series.
Whether the viewer's age limit allows a work, based on its TMDB certification.

alternativeDevice.description: Another GPU that passed this backend's encode test while the configured one failed or is missing.

missingArticles.description: Failed articles with missing-article evidence (NNTP 430), a subset of FailedArticles.

recentBytesPerSecond.description: Recent NNTP ingest rate over a rolling window. Null when nothing arrived recently.

totalExpectedBytes.description: Sum of per-article expected byte weights — the denominator for the fraction ranges.

bufferedBytes.description: Bytes currently buffered from Usenet (downloaded or cache-resident articles).

bufferedRanges.description: Merged payload intervals buffered from Usenet, as fractions of TotalExpectedBytes.

deliveredRanges.description: Merged payload intervals actually served to the client (queried chunks).

ArticleMapResponse.description: Live, bounded diagnostic snapshot of every article in a release.

ArticleProviderAttemptResponse.description: One provider attempt made while retrieving an article.

bytesDownloaded.description: Bytes credited to this provider from successful body transfers.

bytesPerSecond.description: Per-connection transfer rate: credited bytes over their summed transfer time.

ArticleProviderSummaryResponse.description: Aggregate provider outcomes across the release snapshot.

ArticleTelemetryResponse.description: Current transfer state and diagnostic evidence for one ordered release article.

maxChannels.description: Channels the engine decodes for this codec (only checked for direct play; decoders usually downmix).

passthrough.description: True when the engine bitstreams this codec to the audio output (no channel limit).

acceleration.description: Override the configured backend for this run only (none, videotoolbox, vaapi, qsv, nvenc).

ByteRangeResponse.description: A byte-space interval expressed as fractions [0..1] of the release payload.

CachedReleaseResponse.description: One release whose source NZB is available from Core's persistent cache.

incomplete.description: True when at least one indexer failed, so counts may be too low.

error.description: Why the overlay is missing (`capacity_reached`, `search_temporarily_unavailable`); null on success.

CatalogAvailabilityDto.description: How fresh the version overlay is.

genre.description: TMDB genre id the page is filtered by, or null for all genres.

totalPages.description: Pages TMDB has for this query (at most 500); the age gate may leave a page with fewer or no items.

hasMore.description: True while a later page exists; keep paging on this, not on the item count.

items.description: Titles of this page the viewer may watch, in TMDB order.

CatalogBrowseResponse.description: One page of a Movies or Series library page.

rows.description: Rows in display order; rows without any title the viewer may watch are omitted.

aired.description: False for announced episodes whose air date is unknown or in the future.

versionCount.description: Playable versions (season packs included); null unless availability was requested and checked.

id.description: TMDB genre id (pass as `genre` to browse).

name.description: Genre name in the server's TMDB language.

CatalogGenreDto.description: A TMDB genre for the browse filter.

tint.description: Vivid accent from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

CatalogItemDto.description: A movie or series card for search results and home rows (TMDB data only, no availability).

certification.description: The TMDB certification the age gate uses (e.g. `PG-13`, `12`).

tint.description: Vivid accent from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

reason.description: `resume` (in progress), `next` (after the furthest played) or `start` (nothing watched yet).

tint.description: Vivid accent of the series (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade of the series (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

tint.description: Vivid accent from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade from the artwork (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

episodeCount.description: Episodes of the regular seasons as TMDB lists them (may include announced ones).

audio.description: `Atmos`, a channel layout such as `7.1`, `5.1`, `2.0`, else the codec (e.g. `DTS`).

CatalogSpecDto.description: Display labels of the best version by quality; device-independent (it describes what exists).

versions.description: Ranked best first; only versions the server would play (rejected and known-dead ones are left out).

fromCache.description: True when this list was not searched for this request (see `?refresh=true`).

incomplete.description: True when at least one indexer failed; such lists are not cached.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/auth/password — admin self-service password change.

hdrFormats.description: HDR formats the display renders: hdr10, hlg, dolbyvision (overrides supportsHdr when set).

subtitleFormats.description: Subtitle formats the player renders from the original file (srt, ass, webvtt, pgs, vobsub, …).

ClientTimelineRequest.description:
Client-observed spans (e.g. Jellyfin's PlaybackInfo→first delivered frame) POSTed back to
Core so the flamegraph spans both processes. Offsets are ms from the session's timeline t0.

budget.description: The global NNTP connection budget shared across all sessions.

inUse.description: NNTP commands currently occupying a connection across all sessions.

reason.description: unrestricted, within_age_limit, above_age_limit, unrated_allowed, unrated_blocked or rating_unavailable.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: Returned once when a key is minted; carries the one-time plaintext token.

DebugSearchRequest.description: Request body of POST /api/v1/debug/search (BRIEF §6.2). Mirrors the /search params.

DebugSearchResponse.description:
Response of POST /api/v1/debug/search: every release including rejected ones, with
parsed fields, per-rule score breakdown and rejection reasons (BRIEF §6.2). Powers
the ranker-tuning view; still never exposes NZB URLs.

engines.description: Playback engines in the device's order of preference (the built-in `native`/`web` one first, `vlc` when bundled).

vlcAvailable.description: True when the VLC engine can be used on this device.

maxBitrateKbps.description: Optional bandwidth cap of the connection.

DeviceProfileDto.description: What the device can play; the server decides the method from it.

engine.description: `native` (ExoPlayer, AVPlayer), `web` (browser video + hls.js / Safari HLS) or `vlc`.

containers.description: Containers the engine plays from a URL: `mp4`, `mkv`, `webm`, `ts`, `mpeg`, …

subtitleFormats.description: Subtitle formats the engine renders from the original file (`srt`, `ass`, `webvtt`, `pgs`, `vobsub`, …); omitted = not declared.

hls.description: True when the engine plays fMP4 HLS (needed for a server remux or transcode).

maxAudioChannels.description: Channels of the audio output path (2 for stereo, 6 or 8 for a surround receiver); default 2.

hdrToneMapping.description: True when the engine tone-maps HDR10 and HLG to SDR itself (VLC, browsers): such sources then play on it although `hdrFormats` does not list them.

isStreaming.description: True while at least one HTTP stream is open; such files cannot be manually purged.

EphemeralFileResponse.description:
Operational view of one server-managed ephemeral file. SizeBytes counts toward the logical
LRU budget, while StorageBytes reports the currently resident decoded-article footprint.

host.description: Populated only for the `nzb_host_not_allowed` error: the rejected download host.

indexerId.description: Populated only for the `nzb_host_not_allowed` error: the owning indexer's id.

params.description: Machine-readable values for localized messages (e.g. `reason`, `rating`); omitted when empty.

ErrorResponse.description: Typed error envelope rendered consistently by every endpoint.

durationTicks.description: Total playable duration reported by the front-end, in 100 ns ticks.

sessionToken.description:
Opaque Core capability token attributed to this playback. It lets background work bind
progress to the exact ephemeral file without guessing from release or user metadata.

GeneralConfigResponse.description: General config as returned by the config API — the TMDB key is masked.

GeneralConfigWrite.description: Write model for general config. Secret Streamarr.Server.Config.GeneralConfigWrite.TmdbApiKey is write-only.

GpuDeviceResponse.description: A GPU visible to the server: a DRM render node (VA-API/QSV) or an NVIDIA GPU (NVENC) in nvidia-smi numbering.

IndexerDiagnosticDto.description: Per-indexer fan-out diagnostics for the debug view.

allowedDownloadHosts.description: Extra hostnames NZB downloads may use besides the BaseUrl host.

IndexerResponse.description: Indexer as returned by the config API — the API key is masked, never plaintext.

IndexerTestResult.description: Outcome of an indexer connectivity test (BRIEF §6.2 /config/indexers/{id}/test).

allowedDownloadHosts.description: Extra hostnames NZB downloads may use besides the BaseUrl host.

IndexerWrite.description: Write model for indexer create/update. Secret Streamarr.Server.Config.IndexerWrite.ApiKey is write-only.

KeyframeIndexResponse.description: Where a remux's keyframe-accurate segment plan came from.

LocalReleaseAvailabilityEntry.description: One release whose episode-specific pre-download is running or locally complete.

LocalReleaseAvailabilityRequest.description: Scoped query for releases with a pre-download file on Core's local disk.

LocalReleaseAvailabilityResponse.description: Up to 20 disk-backed releases per requested work, scoped to one user and client.

LogEntryResponse.description: One sanitized diagnostic event suitable for display in the management UI.

LogFeedResponse.description: Combined, newest-first diagnostic feed from Core and configured integrations.

LogSourceStatusResponse.description: Availability of one log source at the time the feed was generated.

LoginResponse.description: A minted admin session token and its lifetime.

MeResponse.description: Identity of the caller behind the current bearer token (GET /api/v1/auth/me).

MediaStreamInfo.description:
Neutral media stream shape — deliberately NOT Jellyfin's MediaStream schema
(BRIEF §6.2): the plugin maps this onto Jellyfin's model, other front-ends
consume it as-is.

MetricsResponse.description:
Snapshot returned by GET /api/v1/metrics (BRIEF §10-M7 observability): live sessions,
NNTP connections vs the global budget, cumulative bytes streamed, resolve/fallback
counts, search-cache hit rate, and per-indexer latency.

tint.description: Vivid accent of the series (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade of the series (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

incomplete.description: True when some series could not be checked (e.g. TMDB unavailable).

ParsedFieldsDto.description: The raw parser output for a release (BRIEF §7.1), surfaced for tuning.

PlanReasonResponse.description: A decision reason: stable `code` for clients (localizable with `params`) and an English message.

error.description: Redacted failure classification when phase is "failed".

PlaybackAdmissionResponse.description:
Two-phase playback admission (POST/GET /api/v1/playback-sessions): the POST answers
within a hard budget; "preparing" answers carry a pollable admission id while health
check, materialization, ffprobe and repair analysis continue server-side.

deliveredAs.description: `original` (direct play: the engine switches locally), `copy`, `converted` or `none` (switch to hear it).

reasons.description: Stable codes with `params` for localized texts: the planner's reasons plus track and engine notes.

skipped.description: Higher-ranked methods that were not possible, each with why.

container.description: Container family of the original file (`mkv`, `mp4`, `mpeg`, …).

engine.description: `auto` (default: native, then VLC as §2 ranks them), `native` (never VLC) or `vlc` (always VLC when available).

maxHeight.description: Highest video height the viewer wants; lower than the source means a transcode.

maxBitrateKbps.description: Highest total bitrate the viewer wants (combined with the device's bandwidth cap).

audioLanguage.description: Preferred audio language (ISO 639-1 or 639-2, e.g. `de` or `ger`).

subtitleMode.description: `off`, `forced` (default: only forced subtitles, e.g. for foreign-language scenes) or `always`.

PlaybackPreferencesDto.description: User preferences for one playback; on a switch, set fields replace the current ones.

durationTicks.description: Largest media duration reported for this scope, in 100 ns ticks.

positionTicks.description: Latest playhead position, in 100 ns ticks.

PlaybackRangeResponse.description:
Merged watched-time intervals for one playback scope (work × playback session × user),
folded from progress heartbeats. Spans survive session close, so failed attempts keep
showing where the viewer actually spent time. GET /api/v1/playback-ranges.

sessionToken.description: Capability token this span was watched through; null when the front-end sent none.

PlaybackRangeSpanResponse.description: One watched span of the media timeline, in 100 ns ticks.

revision.description: Increments with every switch; the state belongs to this revision.

pollAfterMs.description: Suggested delay before the next poll; 0 once ready or failed.

attempts.description: Every release tried, in order, with its health (`resolving`, `ready`, `degraded`, `dead`).

resumePositionTicks.description: The viewer's saved position for this work (null = none).

url.description: Capability path relative to the server origin (`/api/v1/stream/{token}` or `/api/v1/transcode/{capability}/master.m3u8`); players need no auth headers.

streamToken.description: The stream capability of the resolved release.

PlaybackResponse.description: One viewer playback: its preparation state and, once `ready`, what to play and why.

workId.description: Canonical movie or episode work id, e.g. `tmdb-movie-603` or `tmdb-tv-1396-s01e01`.

releaseId.description: A version from `/viewer/catalog/works/{workId}/versions`; omitted = the recommended (rank 1) version.

startPositionTicks.description: Where playback starts (default 0); `resumePositionTicks` in the answer is the saved position.

audioStreamIndex.description: Source stream index of the audio track; omitted = chosen from `preferences.audioLanguage`, then the default track.

subtitleStreamIndex.description: Source stream index of the subtitle; `-1` = none; omitted = chosen from `preferences.subtitleMode` and `subtitleLanguage`.

deliveredAs.description: `embedded` (direct play), `webvtt` (HLS rendition of a remux or transcode), `burnedIn` (in the transcoded picture) or `none`.

positionTicks.description: Where the new rendition starts; default = the last reported position.

releaseId.description: Another version of the same work.

stepDown.description: The current method failed on the device: continue with the next one in the ranking.

videoRange.description: What the player receives: `SDR`, `PQ` or `HLG` (a transcode is SDR).

deliveredCodec.description: The video codec the player receives (the source codec unless transcoded).

PreDownloadConfigWrite.description: Partial pre-download policy update; omitted properties retain their current values.

PreDownloadJobResponse.description: Live or recently completed background materialization visible to operators.

tripped.description: True while the provider's circuit breaker is open (failover in effect).

ProviderResponse.description: Provider as returned by the config API — the password is masked, never plaintext.

messageId.description:
Recent article message-id (with or without angle brackets). When omitted, Streamarr
discovers a suitable article through common binary test groups.

durationSeconds.description: Measurement window in seconds (1-15). Defaults to 8.

ProviderSpeedTestRequest.description: Optional tuning for a real provider throughput test.

articleSource.description: Whether the article was found in a test group or supplied by the operator.

ProviderSpeedTestResult.description: Real NNTP payload-throughput result translated into video-streaming headroom.

success.description: True when at least one authenticated connection was established.

achievableConnections.description: How many simultaneous authenticated connections we could open (≤ MaxConnections).

ProviderTestResult.description: Outcome of a provider connectivity test (BRIEF §6.2 /config/providers/{id}/test).

ProviderWrite.description: Write model for provider create/update. Secret Streamarr.Server.Config.ProviderWrite.Password is write-only.

QualityDto.description: Parsed quality attributes of a release (BRIEF §6.2 / §7.1).

ReleaseDto.description:
A ranked release as surfaced by `/search`. The NZB URL and indexer API key are
never present here — they stay server-side (BRIEF §6.2).

ReorderRequest.description: Transactional priority order; every current row id must appear exactly once.

RepairArtifactResponse.description: One published repair artifact in the cache.

events.description: Redacted state-transition log for live debugging (bounded).

RepairJobResponse.description: Admin view of one repair job (GET /api/v1/repairs, /api/v1/repairs/{jobId}).

RepairMetrics.description: Low-cardinality repair counters; failure reasons are disposition names only.

RepairOverviewResponse.description: GET /api/v1/repairs — jobs, artifacts and cache budget at a glance.

phase.description: Coarse phase label for player-facing hints ("recovery", "verify", …).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested delay before a client polls or retries the resolve.

progressiveEligible.description: True when the server would admit a progressive (repair-while-streaming) session.

RepairStatusInfo.description: Structured repair progress attached to resolve responses and status endpoints.

ResolveAttempt.description: One release the resolve pipeline attempted, with its health classification.

viaFallback.description: Resolves that returned a release reached via auto-fallback.

workId.description:
Work that offered the release. Required to disambiguate releases spanning multiple
episodes; omitted by legacy clients whose release ids have a single owner.

requestedById.description: Stable account id in the originating front-end.

requestedByName.description: Display name in the originating front-end.

autoFallback.description:
When true (the default), a release that resolves dead transparently retries the
next-best release of the same work, bounded, and returns the first healthy one
(BRIEF §10-M7). Set false to get the raw classification of exactly this release
plus a Streamarr.Server.Contracts.ResolveResponse.SuggestedFallbackReleaseId for manual retry.

streamUrl.description: Same-origin relative capability path; null when the release is dead.

suggestedFallbackReleaseId.description:
Next-best release of the same work. Set when the resolved release is dead and
auto-fallback is disabled (or exhausted), so a front-end can still retry manually.

fallbackFromReleaseId.description:
When this response is the result of auto-fallback, the release originally
requested (which resolved dead). Null when the requested release resolved directly.

attempts.description:
The chain of releases the resolve pipeline tried, in order, each with its health
classification — so a front-end can surface exactly what happened (BRIEF §10-M7).

originHealth.description:
Upstream availability evidence, independent of local repair:
"unknown" | "ready" | "degraded" | "dead". Additive; absent on older servers.

playability.description:
How the release is playable right now:
"remoteReady" | "progressive" | "repairing" | "repairedReady" | "unavailable".
A locally repaired release reports Status "ready" for old clients while
OriginHealth stays "dead".

ResolveResponse.description: Response of POST /api/v1/resolve — the exact shape from BRIEF §6.2.

ScoreLineDto.description: One line of the score breakdown (BRIEF §7.3): a rule and its point value.

hitRate.description: Hit / (hit + miss); 0 when no lookups have happened yet.

SearchResponse.description:
Response of GET /api/v1/search — only works with at least one accepted release;
rejected releases remain available exclusively through the debug contract.

totalEpisodes.description: Episodes of the regular seasons (same basis as Streamarr.Server.Viewers.Catalog.CatalogSeriesResponse.EpisodeCount).

incomplete.description: True when TMDB could not be asked for the next episode.

SeriesWatchSummaryDto.description: The viewer's progress through a series.

SessionRepairStatusResponse.description: Capability-token-bound repair status for an active session (no ids beyond the job).

isStreaming.description: True while at least one HTTP stream is open over this session's file.

runTimeTicks.description: Probed media duration in ticks, once ffprobe has run. Null when unknown.

requiredBytesPerSecond.description:
Average byte rate the media needs for realtime playback (SizeBytes / duration).
Null until the duration has been probed.

downloadBytesPerSecond.description: Recent NNTP ingest rate for this session (rolling window). Null when idle.

failedArticles.description: Articles currently failed for this session's release (0 when untracked).

missingArticles.description: Failed articles with missing-article evidence (NNTP 430), a subset of FailedArticles.

activeArticles.description: Articles currently queued or downloading (0 when untracked).

bufferedPercent.description: Share of the release payload buffered from Usenet; 100 once fully on disk.

bufferedRanges.description: Compact buffered payload intervals (fractions), for overview timeline rails.

timelineStartedAt.description: Wall-clock instant of timeline t0 (resolve start), for aligning client spans.

timeline.description: Request→first-frame spans for the flamegraph on the stream page (may be empty).

SessionResponse.description: One live session as listed by GET /api/v1/sessions.

StartRepairRequest.description: POST /api/v1/repairs — idempotent manual start for a registered release.

minimumFreeBytes.description: Pre-downloads pause below this free-space floor (PreDownload.MinimumFreeDiskBytes).

StorageDisk.description: Volume hosting the pre-download workspace (the only disk-heavy cache Streamarr writes).

StorageEphemeral.description: Logical ephemeral-cache occupancy (capability files counted against the LRU byte budget).

StorageNzbLibrary.description: Persistent NZB cache (SQLite metadata + .nzb files on disk).

StoragePreDownload.description: Materialized pre-download files currently on disk.

StorageResponse.description:
Operator-facing storage overview for the Files screen (GET /api/v1/storage): what Streamarr
currently keeps in memory and on disk, against which budgets, and how much disk is left.

StorageSegmentCache.description: In-memory decoded-article LRU shared by all sessions.

StreamEventResponse.description: One chronological diagnostic log entry for a Streamarr.Server.Contracts.StreamRecordResponse.

timelineStartedAt.description: Wall-clock instant of timeline t0, for aligning the flamegraph (matches SessionResponse.TimelineStartedAt).

timeline.description: Request→first-frame spans only (same shape as the live console's flamegraph).

events.description: Every recorded event, chronological — ttff spans, folded-in PAR2 repair transitions, session lifecycle, errors.

StreamRecordResponse.description: One stream-history record with its full, time-ordered diagnostic event log.

token.description: The real session token when one was minted, otherwise a synthetic attempt id.

finalState.description: Null while open; terminal values include closed, interrupted, expired, evicted, purged, invalidated, reused, dead, and error.

StreamRecordSummaryResponse.description:
One row of the permanent stream-attempt history (BRIEF §11 console) — the last N stream
attempts, live or long since closed, so a report like "this release errored around 9pm"
can be looked up after the fact. List-view shape; omits the event timeline.

StreamingHistoryResponse.description: One event in the cross-front-end streaming history.

SubtitleTrackResponse.description: A source subtitle stream and how this plan delivers it: `webvtt` rendition (remux and transcode), `embedded` (direct play), `burnedIn` or `none`.

stoppedByServer.description: True when Streamarr stopped the run on purpose (idle player, session closed), so a non-zero exit code is expected.

mode.description: `direct` (play the original file), `remux` (stream copy into HLS) or `transcode`.

reasons.description: Why this mode: direct-play blockers a remux solves, audio handling, or why the video must be re-encoded.

encoder.description: ffmpeg video encoder of a transcode; `copy` for a remux, `none` for direct play.

streamToken.description: A live stream capability returned by /resolve (the path token of `/api/v1/stream/{token}`).

sampleId.description: A built-in test sample id (administrators only).

subtitleStreamIndex.description: The subtitle stream the viewer wants; an image-based one a remux or transcode cannot deliver (no burn-in) gets the reason `subtitle_not_deliverable`; text streams become WebVTT renditions.

mode.description: `auto` (remux when the video can be copied), `remux` (fail with 422 otherwise) or `transcode`. Sessions default to `transcode`, the plan endpoint to `auto`.

firstSegmentReadyMs.description: Create request → first segment written by ffmpeg.

firstSegmentServedMs.description: Create request → first segment delivered to the player.

TranscodeStartupResponse.description: Where a session's time to first segment went, measured on the server from the create request.

videoCopy.description: True for a remux or direct play: the video bitstream reaches the player unchanged.

videoRange.description: HLS VIDEO-RANGE of the output: SDR, PQ or HLG.

audioCodec.description: Output audio codec (the source codec when copied).

TranscodeTargetResponse.description: What the player receives: the original streams for direct play, the copied video for a remux, the encoder output for a transcode.

maxConcurrentRemuxes.description: Concurrent stream-copy (remux) runs; a separate pool because a copy costs a fraction of an encode.

ffmpegPath.description: Host-level paths; only configurable through environment/appsettings.

nvencDevice.description: NVIDIA GPU index for NVENC/NVDEC in nvidia-smi (PCI bus) order.

TranscodingConfigWrite.description: Partial update; omitted fields keep their value.

TtffSpanResponse.description: One measured stage on the request→first-frame timeline (flamegraph on the stream page).

TvSeasonDetailsResponse.description:
A canonical season directory with accepted releases overlaid per episode. Every TMDB
episode remains present even when no accepted release was found.

TvSeriesDetailsResponse.description: A series plus its lazily discoverable season directory.

TvSeriesDto.description: A series-level work shown before any season performs an indexer search.

TvSeriesSearchResponse.description: TMDB-ranked TV series candidates. The endpoint is intentionally capped at three.

rank.description: Position in the default order, 1 = first. With a device profile: the best quality that plays without a server transcode first (see `qualityRank`).

qualityRank.description: Position by quality and health alone, independent of the device (1 = best).

recommended.description: The version the server picks when the client does not choose one (rank 1); never set for a version the device cannot play.

bitDepth.description: Stated in the name, or 10 when it names an HDR format (HDR needs at least 10 bits).

hdr.description: Headline HDR format: `dolbyvision`, `hdr10plus`, `hdr10` or `hlg`; null = SDR or not stated.

hdrFormats.description: Every HDR format named, headline first (Dolby Vision releases often carry an `hdr10` base layer).

subtitleHints.description: `subbed`, `multi`, `hardcoded`; empty = the name says nothing about subtitles.

seasonPack.description: A whole-season release; Streamarr.Server.Viewers.Catalog.VersionDto.SizeBytes is the full pack.

estimatedBitrateKbps.description: Size ÷ TMDB runtime (per episode for season packs); null when the runtime is unknown.

ageDays.description: Days since the release was posted.

health.description: `unknown` (not checked yet), `ready` or `degraded` (last resolve found missing articles).

local.description: `ready` or `downloading` when a pre-download of this version exists for the viewer; else null.

predictedMethod.description: Prediction only (`direct`, `remux`, `transcode`, `unknown`; `vlc` when the request sent `vlcAvailable=true`) from the name and the sent device profile; the server decides at playback.

predictionReasons.description: Why, plus every assumption the prediction made (e.g. `container_assumed`).

VersionDto.description: One playable version, derived from the parsed release name plus server state; codes are lower-case, null = not stated.

maxBitDepth.description: Highest decodable bit depth; default 8 for H.264 and 10 for HEVC/AV1/VP9.

hdrFormats.description: HDR formats rendered for this codec: `hdr10`, `hlg`, `dolbyvision`.

ViewerAuthResponse.description: Either a second-factor challenge or a signed-in session.

password.description: Leave empty to generate a password that is returned once.

mustChangePassword.description: Defaults to true for generated passwords.

email.description: New address; empty removes the email from the account.

mode.description: disabled, smtp or outbox (test mode: messages are only captured, never sent).

smtpPassword.description: Write-only; reads return a mask when set. Omit or send the mask to keep it, empty string clears it.

useCookies.description: Browser clients: keep tokens in HttpOnly cookies instead of the response body.

maxAge.description: Highest allowed minimum age (0, 6, 12, 16, 18); null = unrestricted.

code.description: 6-digit authenticator code or a recovery code.

email.description: New address (trusted as verified); empty string removes it; null keeps it.

unlock.description: Clears an active lockout and the failed-attempt counter.

workId.description: Canonical movie or episode work id, e.g. `tmdb-movie-603` or `tmdb-tv-1396-s01e01`.

playbackId.description: Id of one playback, used to count a completed play exactly once; a `/viewer/playback` id of this device also fills `releaseId`/`streamToken`, keeps that playback alive, and `stop` ends it.

releaseId.description: Optional (filled from a server playback): forwards the report to the shared event stream (pre-download, notifications).

tint.description: Vivid accent of the title (series for episodes) (`#RRGGBB`, at least 3:1 against `#0A0C12`); continue watching only, null until computed.

tint2.description: Deep shade of the title (series for episodes) (`#RRGGBB`, white text reaches 4.5:1 on it); continue watching only, null until computed.

highlight.description: Bright colour of the backdrop behind the TV glass (`#RRGGBB`, 95th luminance percentile); null when unknown.

workIds.description: Movie/episode ids; for played/unplayed also season (`tmdb-tv-1-s02`) or series (`tmdb-tv-1`) ids.

WorkDto.description: One aggregated work with its ranked releases (BRIEF §6.2 / §7.4).

bearer.description: Machine API key or admin session JWT.

tags.name: ViewerAdmin
tags.description: Admin management of viewer (watch) accounts and the viewer module. Viewers never reach these endpoints.

tags.name: ViewerAuth
tags.description: Viewer sign-in, token refresh and sign-out. Separate from the admin `/api/v1/auth` endpoints.

tags.name: ViewerCatalog
tags.description: What a viewer can watch: TMDB search and home rows, title details with watch state, and ranked versions.

tags.name: ViewerMe
tags.description: The signed-in viewer's own account: profile, password, email, two-factor and devices.

tags.name: ViewerPlayback
tags.description: Viewer playback: asynchronous preparation (resolve, fallback, repair, plan, start) with a pollable state, switches and stop.

tags.name: ViewerWatch
tags.description: The signed-in viewer's watch state: progress reports, continue watching, next up, history and played flags.

tags.name: TranscodeStream
tags.description:
Capability-authorized HLS rendition of a transcode session. Like `/api/v1/stream`, the unguessable path token is the
only credential, so plain players (hls.js, Safari, TVs) can fetch playlists and segments without auth headers.

tags.name: Transcoding
tags.description: Server-side transcoding: settings, hardware diagnostics, test media, benchmarks and HLS session creation.

tags.name: ApiKeys
tags.description:
Machine API key management (BRIEF §6.4 / §9.1). The plaintext token is returned only
once, at creation; thereafter only its prefix and metadata are visible. Keys are
revoked (soft-deleted), not hard-deleted, so past issuance stays auditable.
Admin session required — machine keys cannot mint or revoke keys (BRIEF §6.4).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description:
Admin session auth (BRIEF §6.4): username/password login issuing a short-lived JWT that
unlocks everything including /config and /debug, the caller's identity, and admin
password change. Login itself is anonymous; the rest require a valid session.

tags.name: Caps
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/caps (BRIEF §6.2): the categories the configured indexers search and the
providers streaming can draw from — a front-end's view of what this server supports.

tags.name: Download
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/download/{token} — the same capability-authorized session as
GET /api/v1/stream/{token} (Streamarr.Server.Controllers.StreamController), served at full transport
speed instead of paced for real-time playback, with an attachment
`Content-Disposition` so any HTTP client saves the complete file. Callers that want
the whole file as fast as the configured Usenet provider(s) allow — rather than paced to
match playback — use this sibling instead of `/stream`. Player-agnostic by contract;
no Jellyfin-specific behavior may ever be added here (mirrors Streamarr.Server.Controllers.StreamController).

tags.name: Events
tags.description:
POST /api/v1/events — ingests playback events from any front-end into SQLite
(BRIEF §6.1 module 7 / §6.2). This is how watch state escapes a front-end's own DB.

tags.name: GeneralConfig
tags.description:
General config GET/PUT (BRIEF §6.2): TMDB key, TTLs, cache sizes, NNTP budget. The
TMDB credential is write-only (masked on read, omit-to-keep on write) and takes effect
immediately. The indexer result limit also applies immediately; other scalars require a restart.

tags.name: Health
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/health: anonymous, shallow liveness by default. Credentialed dependency
diagnostics require an admin JWT and are shared/cached to prevent probe amplification.

tags.name: Indexers
tags.description:
Indexer config CRUD + connectivity test (BRIEF §6.2). Secrets are write-only:
GETs return a masked API key; PUT omits-to-keep. Admin session required (BRIEF §6.4).

tags.name: Library
tags.description: Admin library of releases backed by Core's persistent NZB cache.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: Bounded, sanitized diagnostics from Core and the optional Jellyfin integration.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/metrics (BRIEF §10-M7 observability): a JSON snapshot of sessions,
NNTP connections vs the global budget, cumulative bytes streamed, resolve/fallback
counts, search-cache hit rate, and per-indexer latency. Admin-only, like session
listing, because provider/indexer names and circuit state are operational inventory.

tags.name: PlaybackRanges
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/playback-ranges — watched-time intervals per playback scope, folded from
front-end heartbeats. The debugging complement to /api/v1/events: not "where is the
playhead" but "which parts of the timeline were actually watched, via which release".

tags.name: PlaybackSessions
tags.description:
Two-phase playback admission keeps slow preparation off the initial HTTP request.
Jellyfin's global live-stream lock remains held while OpenMediaSource polls it.
Uses the same machine-auth posture and validation as POST /api/v1/resolve.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description:
Quality profile CRUD (BRIEF §6.2 / §7.3). The built-in default profile is always
listed and cannot be edited or deleted; user profiles are stored as JSON. No secrets.
Admin session required (BRIEF §6.4).

tags.name: Providers
tags.description:
Usenet provider config CRUD + connectivity test (BRIEF §6.2, DECISIONS.md #6).
The password is write-only: GETs return it masked; PUT omits-to-keep.
Admin session required (BRIEF §6.4).

tags.name: Repairs
tags.description:
Repair job observability and control. Admin-scoped except the capability-token-bound
per-session status. Responses never contain message-ids, paths or credentials.

tags.name: Resolve
tags.description: POST /api/v1/resolve (BRIEF §6.2).

tags.name: Search
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/search + POST /api/v1/debug/search (BRIEF §6.2). Both run the identical
pipeline via Streamarr.Server.Services.SearchService; the debug endpoint also preserves raw buckets
and projects parsed fields, score breakdown, rejection reasons, and indexer diagnostics.
Neither ever exposes an NZB URL or indexer API key.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: GET /api/v1/sessions + POST /api/v1/sessions/{token}/close (BRIEF §6.2).

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: GET /api/v1/storage — operator storage overview for the Files screen.

tags.name: Stream
tags.description:
GET/HEAD /api/v1/stream/{token} — a capability-authorized, Range-capable HTTP byte
stream (BRIEF §3.3): honors `Range: bytes=…` with 206 + Content-Range +
Accept-Ranges, serves the full body otherwise, and seeks anywhere — including
inside RAR-wrapped files. Player-agnostic by contract; no Jellyfin-specific
behavior may ever be added here.

tags.name: StreamHistory
tags.description:
GET /api/v1/streams(/{token}) — the permanent stream-attempt history (BRIEF §11 console):
the last `MaxRetainedStreams` resolve attempts, live or long since closed, each with
its full diagnostic event timeline. Distinct from the live-only `/api/v1/sessions` and
the byte-range `/api/v1/stream/{token}`.

tags.name: TvCatalog
tags.description: Lazy TV series → season → episode catalog endpoints.
